result.reason: The clause adopts New York law and exclusive New York County courts, but it retains language permitting arbitral awards to be confirmed in any competent court, including where the opposing party resides. That conflicts with the required exclusive New York County forum and should be deleted along with the obsolete arbitration references. The remaining orphaned “(b)” also makes the provision structurally incomplete. The edits otherwise are limited to the governing-law and dispute-forum terms and preserve unrelated provisions.
